item.description: The DomainLookupTestCase fails with "Domain 'a' not found in fragment hierarchy" because the lookup_domain method in the Design class has flawed logic for traversing the fragment hierarchy to find domains.
item.contract: The lookup_domain method in the Design class should correctly traverse the fragment hierarchy to find a domain by name. It must: 1. Iterate through the fragment hierarchy properly 2. Access domains via the correct mechanism (fragment.domains) 3. Handle cases where fragments may not be in the design's fragment mapping 4. Return the correct ClockDomain object when found 5. Raise KeyError with appropriate message when domain is not found

item.description: Multiple simulator tests fail with "'NoneType' object has no attribute 'xxx'" because the simulator engine isn't properly initialized or returned, and background testbenches are not yet implemented.
item.contract: The simulator should properly initialize and manage engine instances. Specifically: 1. The add_testbench method should properly handle background processes (currently raises NotImplementedError) 2. All simulator methods should properly return valid engine objects instead of None 3. Engine initialization should be robust and not produce None returns

item.description: Missing import for 'BrokenTrigger' in simulator tests indicates that the test suite is referencing undefined symbols.
item.contract: The test suite should properly define or import all referenced symbols. Specifically: 1. BrokenTrigger class should be defined or imported in the test file 2. Any missing imports should be resolved

item.description: RTLIL backend memory test failures occur due to incomplete implementation of memory operations in the RTLIL backend.
item.contract: The RTLIL backend should properly implement memory operations for both async and sync read ports: 1. Async read memory operations should work correctly 2. Sync read memory operations should work correctly with transparency handling 3. Memory initialization should be handled properly 4. Memory read/write port connections should be accurate
